votes.reason: This was my own value pick: 21.5x trailing is a fair price for a sound defense prime, though most of the +52.8% EPS growth is a rebound from the program charges that hit the prior four quarters, so the case rests on the multiple rather than the growth figure.

At 24.3x trailing on 8.6% EPS growth it has the highest multiple in the book and is not cheap, but it is a sound, steadily profitable business and nothing in my table gives a concrete value reason against it this week.
This was my own value pick: 16.2x trailing on 13.4% EPS growth, with the lowest 12-week volatility in the book at 2.24% weekly, is the clearest cheap-and-sound case here.

At 23.8x trailing on 8.9% EPS growth after a +21.23% 12-week run it is fully priced rather than cheap, but it is a sound, profitable franchise and my lens gives no concrete reason against it this week.
